creators.name: Shantell Martin
creators.bio: Artist known for continuous black-and-white line drawings and words; collaborated with Zach Lieberman on Poem World for Snap Spectacles.
creators.why: Brings a drawn, hand-made line into spatial text — words you walk through.

works.title: Spark AR sketches (retrospective)
works.description: A reel of the face and world effects Zach made for Instagram's Spark AR before the platform shut down: generative type, face distortions and drawn trails.
works.idea_zh: 回顾自己在 Spark AR 上做的一系列即时可分享的脸部与世界特效。
works.technique: Face-mesh tracking and segmentation in Spark AR drive shader-based distortions and generative graphics that anyone can open instantly from a link.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 Effect House 做一个“一眼就能看懂”的脸部特效，并在 10 分钟内发给三个人试玩；变体：让效果只在两人同时入镜时出现。

works.title: Poem World (Snap Spectacles)
works.description: A short poem by Shantell Martin laid out as lines of text in space that you read by walking through them, recorded through Snap's AR Spectacles.
works.idea_zh: 一首可以走进去读的诗：文字排布在空间里，读诗就是走路。
works.technique: World-tracked text meshes are placed along a path in Lens Studio; the reading order is set by where the wearer walks rather than by scrolling.
works.exercise_zh: 把一首短诗拆成词句，用 AR 摆放在走廊或操场上，让“读”变成一条行走路线；变体：让某些词只在你停下来时才出现。

works.title: Weird Type skate trails
works.description: Skateboarder Christopher Ledwig uses the Weird Type app to leave a trail of text following his skateboard's motion through space (shared by Zach).
works.idea_zh: 让一个 AR 文字工具被别人拿去玩出新花样：用文字画出滑板的轨迹。
works.technique: The app samples the phone's world-tracked pose each frame and emits typographic glyphs along that path, so moving the camera draws text in 3D.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个“移动手机就能在空中留下文字轨迹”的小工具，再请同学用运动（跑、跳、滑板）去用它；变体：让文字内容随速度变化。

works.title: Pinball table in your room (WebXR)
works.description: A web pinball game that also runs in AR on a headset: the table appears in your real space, wired up with about 100 lines of react-three/xr.
works.idea_zh: 把网页弹珠台一键变成摆在你房间里的 AR 版本。
works.technique: The existing three.js scene is wrapped in a WebXR AR session via react-three/xr, with the table anchored to a hit-tested floor or table surface and controller/hand input mapped to flippers.
works.exercise_zh: 把你之前做过的一个网页 3D 小游戏用 WebXR 改成 AR 版，摆在真实桌面上玩；变体：让桌子的真实边缘成为游戏里的墙。

works.title: AR glasses superpowers for illustrators
works.description: A prototype imagining how AR glasses could let an illustrator or animator draw and see animated overlays directly on paper and the desk.
works.idea_zh: 想象 AR 眼镜给插画师的“超能力”：纸上的画直接动起来。
works.technique: Likely combines a tracked sheet of paper (image or plane tracking) with animated overlays rendered in-place so drawings and animation guides align with the physical page.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像追踪识别一张手绘稿，在纸上叠加一段会动的动画；变体：让画中角色能“走出”纸面到桌上。

works.title: Vision Pro pinball with pinch haptics
works.description: Pinball played on Apple Vision Pro using pinch gestures for the flippers; the tactile pinch of your own fingers stands in for button feedback.
works.idea_zh: 用手指捏合当弹珠台按钮：身体自带的触感就是反馈。
works.technique: visionOS hand tracking detects thumb–index pinch events and maps each hand's pinch to a flipper, relying on the self-contact of the fingers as passive haptic feedback.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个只用“捏合”手势的 AR 小游戏，利用手指相碰本身的触感当反馈；变体：左右手分别控制不同的机制。
